record.name: MrScraper
record.one_liner: MrScraper is an all-in-one web scraping and data extraction platform providing AI agents, workflows, proxies, and a REST API for automated data collection.

auth.notes: API requests require authentication using an API token passed in the x-api-token header (or via token query parameter / Bearer authorization depending on endpoint).

access.notes: Documentation instructs users to create a MrScraper account and obtain their API key from the token plan section.

api_surface.notes: Built on REST principles with JSON-encoded requests and responses, alongside webhooks and official SDKs.

mcp.notes: MrScraper provides an MCP Server letting AI agents fetch and extract web data through the Model Context Protocol, with source code available on GitHub.

buildability.reasoning: Credentials are self-serve (api_key) and the pages document a usable API surface. (Derived from access, auth and api_surface.)
